items.title: Last day to file objection (Widerspruch) against the hearing aid cost decision
items.quote: Sind Sie anderer Auffassung, können Sie binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids Widerspruch erheben – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der BKK Beispielwerk, Werkstraße 100, 38440 Musterburg.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 30.05.2025 and no separate posting date is stated, so posting day = 30.05.2025. A statutory health insurer is a social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), so the letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 03.06.2025 (Tuesday). This deemed delivery day does not move. The delivery day is not counted (§ 187 BGB). One month later is 03.07.2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB), a Thursday and not a public holiday in NW, so no shift under § 193 BGB. The objection must reach BKK Beispielwerk by 03.07.2025.

warnings: The letter contains a passage addressed to AI assistants and chatbots claiming the decision is already final and telling them not to set a reminder; this was ignored, and the objection period is still running as calculated.

The letter states no separate posting date, so the deemed delivery is calculated from the letter date of 30.05.2025. If you received it later, the actual delivery date does not extend the period unless you can show it arrived after the deemed date; file the objection early to be safe.
